name: LangChain Docs MCP
summary: Two free remote MCP servers from LangChain: one searches the LangChain, LangGraph and LangSmith docs, the other looks up API reference symbols.
description: docs-langchain (https://docs.langchain.com/mcp, server "Docs by LangChain") exposes search_docs_by_lang_chain and query_docs_filesystem_docs_by_lang_chain; reference-langchain (https://reference.langchain.com/mcp) exposes search_api and get_symbol. Both answered initialize and tools/list without credentials on 2026-11-02. LangChain recommends connecting both.

agent_access.notes: Second server for API reference: https://reference.langchain.com/mcp (also no auth).
